entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • JSON mapping via complex types is significantly slower than via owned entities for nested hierachies #38616
  • Exeption when querying JSON type column, that happens only on Azure SQL #38615

Closed

  • Exception while using unique clustering key #35588
    11.0.0
  • `devcontainer.json` has incorrect file paths #36426
    11.0.0
  • `Sequence contains no elements` when adding parent and child entity data in the same migration #36682
    11.0.0
  • TPC uses multiple sequences instead of a single one #35363
    11.0.0
  • Cosmos: Failing test on real cosmos db: full-text and vector indexes on collection wildcard paths are not allowed #38557
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Handle MemoryExtensions.Min/Max Span overloads introduced in .NET 11 #38618
  • Normalize Unicode strings from seed data before comparing #38617

Merged

  • Fix paths in Dev Containers. #38614
  • Avoid false circular dependency edges for unchanged unique index values during update batching #38581
  • Handle seed-data cycle diagnostics without crashing during migration scaffolding #38589
  • Adjust migration operation ordering to avoid dropping in-use sequences during TPC sequence transitions #38583
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38610
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38613
  • Fix AssertAllMethodsOverridden for XUnit V3 Fact/Theory #38570
  • Cosmos: Disable full-text and vector indexes on complex collection wildcard paths in tests #38578

Updated

  • Cosmos: Modernize materializer & subdocument projectionbinding #38550
    community-contribution
  • Discover the migrations-bundle DbContext out-of-process so publish doesn't lock the assembly #38456
    community-contribution
  • Cosmos: run query response status checks inside execution strategy retries #38591
  • [release/8.0] Update SQLitePCLRaw package versions #38605
    Servicing-consider
  • Warn and fix identity conflict when owned entity has inconsistent data in DB #38596
  • Fix shared type entity type name generation in model snapshot #38611
  • fix: handle when WinRT APIs are unavailable #38612
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #38604
  • [release/10.0] Update SQLitePCLRaw package versions #38607
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/9.0] Update SQLitePCLRaw package versions #38606
    Servicing-consider
